description: NaCa₂GeO₄F is Ilmenite-derived structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.53 Å. There is one shorter (2.58 Å) and one longer (2.71 Å) Na-F bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.52 Å. There is one shorter (2.57 Å) and one longer (2.59 Å) Na-F bond length. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.54 Å. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.52 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.50 Å. There is one shorter (2.69 Å) and one longer (2.72 Å) Na-F bond length. There are eight inequivalent Ca sites. In the first Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.36 Å. There is one shorter (2.49 Å) and one longer (2.55 Å) Ca-F bond length. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.43 Å. Both Ca-F bond lengths are 2.42 Å. In the third Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.43 Å. There is one shorter (2.37 Å) and one longer (2.39 Å) Ca-F bond length. In the fourth Ca site, Ca is bonded to four O and two F atoms to form distorted CaO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₄F₂ pentagonal pyramids and corners with four GeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.41 Å. There is one shorter (2.34 Å) and one longer (2.45 Å) Ca-F bond length. In the fifth Ca site, Ca is bonded to four O and two F atoms to form distorted CaO₄F₂ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with four GeO₄ tetrahedra and  a faceface with one CaO₄F₂ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.40 Å. There is one shorter (2.31 Å) and one longer (2.42 Å) Ca-F bond length. In the sixth Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.38 Å. There is one shorter (2.42 Å) and one longer (2.45 Å) Ca-F bond length. In the seventh Ca site, Ca is bonded to four O and two F atoms to form distorted CaO₄F₂ pentagonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₄F₂ pentagonal pyramid, corners with four GeO₄ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one CaO₄F₂ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.48 Å. There is one shorter (2.46 Å) and one longer (2.50 Å) Ca-F bond length. In the eighth Ca site, Ca is bonded to four O and two F atoms to form distorted CaO₄F₂ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent CaO₄F₂ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one CaO₄F₂ pentagonal pyramid, and corners with four GeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-11°. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.36 Å. There is one shorter (2.41 Å) and one longer (2.50 Å) Ca-F bond length. There are four inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₄F₂ octahedra and corners with two equivalent CaO₄F₂ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-50°. There are two shorter (1.77 Å) and two longer (1.80 Å) Ge-O bond lengths. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four CaO₄F₂ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.80 Å. In the third Ge site, Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three CaO₄F₂ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.80 Å. In the fourth Ge site, Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₄F₂ octahedra and corners with three CaO₄F₂ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 56-69°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.82 Å. There are sixteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Ca and one Ge atom to form OCa₃Ge tetrahedra that share corners with six FNa₂Ca₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-61°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two Ca, and one Ge atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ca, and one Ge atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ca, and one Ge atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two Ca, and one Ge atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two Ca, and one Ge atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Ca and one Ge atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Ca, and one Ge atom to form ONa₂CaGe tetrahedra that share corners with six FNa₂Ca₄ octahedra and corners with two equivalent ONa₂CaGe trigonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-60°. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Ca, and one Ge atom to form ONaCa₂Ge tetrahedra that share corners with six FNa₂Ca₄ octahedra and corners with two equivalent ONa₂CaGe trigonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-61°. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two Ca, and one Ge atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Ca and one Ge atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two Ca, and one Ge atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two Ca, and one Ge atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two Ca, and one Ge atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Ca, and one Ge atom to form distorted ONa₂CaGe trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one FNa₂Ca₄ octahedra, corners with four ONa₂CaGe tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one FNa₂Ca₄ octahedra, and  a faceface with one FNa₂Ca₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 43°. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Ca, and one Ge atom to form ONaCa₂Ge tetrahedra that share corners with six FNa₂Ca₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-63°. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to two Na and four Ca atoms to form distorted FNa₂Ca₄ octahedra that share corners with six OCa₃Ge tetrahedra, faces with two equivalent FNa₂Ca₄ octahedra, and  a faceface with one ONa₂CaGe trigonal pyramid. In the second F site, F is bonded to two Na and four Ca atoms to form FNa₂Ca₄ octahedra that share corners with six OCa₃Ge tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent FNa₂Ca₄ octahedra. In the third F site, F is bonded to two Na and four Ca atoms to form FNa₂Ca₄ octahedra that share corners with six OCa₃Ge tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂CaGe trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂CaGe trigonal pyramid, and faces with two equivalent FNa₂Ca₄ octahedra. In the fourth F site, F is bonded to two Na and four Ca atoms to form FNa₂Ca₄ octahedra that share corners with six OCa₃Ge tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent FNa₂Ca₄ octahedra.
